parts.prose: Technology project governance is commensurate with risk and complexity: oversight roles, authority and reporting structures, and risk assessments throughout the project life cycle

parts.prose: Changes to source code of critical systems undergo source code review for security and recognised coding practices before introduction

parts.prose: System changes are independently reviewed and approved; contingency plans for unsuccessful material changes are established and tested

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Contracts for critical systems developed or maintained by third parties require sufficient notice of impacting changes, demonstrated secure-by-design development, and continued accessibility of source code for business continuity

controls.title: Decommissioning of critical systems minimises customer and business impact, with contingency plans established and tested for unsuccessful decommissioning

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Decommissioning of critical systems minimises customer and business impact, with contingency plans established and tested for unsuccessful decommissioning

controls.title: Robust policies identify and reduce shadow IT risks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Robust policies identify and reduce shadow IT risks

controls.title: No system or digital service runs with known security vulnerabilities, on outdated platforms or end-of-life technology: a current security hardening baseline, timely patching, remedial plans for appro

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No system or digital service runs with known security vulnerabilities, on outdated platforms or end-of-life technology: a current security hardening baseline, timely patching, remedial plans for approaching EOL, and management-approved, risk-assessed, annually reviewed exceptions with phase-out timelines

controls.title: A patch and EOL management framework covers asset identification and risk assessment, deployment criteria, priority and turnaround by severity, compatibility testing, an end-to-end approval, testing,

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A patch and EOL management framework covers asset identification and risk assessment, deployment criteria, priority and turnaround by severity, compatibility testing, an end-to-end approval, testing, monitoring and tracking workflow, and end-user awareness

controls.title: The effectiveness and security of technology in use is monitored against disruptive developments (e.g. quantum computing): board advice on impact, a long-term strategy with competent resources, and a

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The effectiveness and security of technology in use is monitored against disruptive developments (e.g. quantum computing): board advice on impact, a long-term strategy with competent resources, and a migration roadmap

controls.title: Project risk assessments address resource adequacy including vendors and concurrent projects, system complexity and integration, security controls through the life cycle, completeness of user requirem

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Project risk assessments address resource adequacy including vendors and concurrent projects, system complexity and integration, security controls through the life cycle, completeness of user requirements, robustness of testing, deployment and fallback strategies, and disaster recovery readiness

controls.title: A cryptography policy requires industry-standard algorithms, message authentication, hashes, signatures and random number generation; secure key life-cycle management; at least annual review of standa

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A cryptography policy requires industry-standard algorithms, message authentication, hashes, signatures and random number generation; secure key life-cycle management; at least annual review of standards and algorithms for critical and customer-facing systems; an asset inventory of cryptographic tools and algorithms with rationale and mappings; and tested compromise-recovery plans

controls.title: Cryptographic controls are evaluated with due diligence; the institution retains ownership and control of encryption keys (or with an independent custodian) except for non-critical systems without cus

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic controls are evaluated with due diligence; the institution retains ownership and control of encryption keys (or with an independent custodian) except for non-critical systems without customer information, manages externally generated keys to industry standards, weighs reliance on third-party assessments against risk appetite, and considers resource impact and reduced traffic visibility

controls.title: Cryptographic protocols for secret and public keys follow recognised international standards and are tested; secret and private key storage and computation occur in a protected environment (HSM, TEE o

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic protocols for secret and public keys follow recognised international standards and are tested; secret and private key storage and computation occur in a protected environment (HSM, TEE or equivalent) commensurate with risk

controls.title: Public keys are stored in certificates from a Certificate Authority (recognised CAs for customers); authentication and signature protocols protect private keys so their use is legally binding; issuanc

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Public keys are stored in certificates from a Certificate Authority (recognised CAs for customers); authentication and signature protocols protect private keys so their use is legally binding; issuance and renewal follow industry and legal specifications

controls.title: Resilience and availability objectives of data centres are specified to support business recovery objectives

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Resilience and availability objectives of data centres are specified to support business recovery objectives

controls.title: Data centres have redundant capacity components and multiple distribution paths with no single point of failure

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Data centres have redundant capacity components and multiple distribution paths with no single point of failure

controls.title: Critical systems are hosted in dedicated, physically secured production data centre space not in a disaster-prone area, with no single point of failure in hardware, electrical, thermal and infrastruct

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Critical systems are hosted in dedicated, physically secured production data centre space not in a disaster-prone area, with no single point of failure in hardware, electrical, thermal and infrastructure design, and with adequate maintenance and continuous monitoring with timely alerts

controls.title: Data centre operations have control procedures including automated batch management, production change procedures, error handling and exception management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Data centre operations have control procedures including automated batch management, production change procedures, error handling and exception management

controls.title: Incompatible activities in data centre operations are segregated (development from operations); necessary vendor or programmer access to production is authorised and monitored

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incompatible activities in data centre operations are segregated (development from operations); necessary vendor or programmer access to production is authorised and monitored

controls.title: System capacity is planned and managed for peak periods, growth plans and architecture changes

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: System capacity is planned and managed for peak periods, growth plans and architecture changes

controls.title: The board and senior management receive and review timely reports on significant project risks throughout implementation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The board and senior management receive and review timely reports on significant project risks throughout implementation

controls.title: Real-time monitoring tracks capacity utilisation and performance of key processes and services with actionable alerts; scope, metrics and thresholds are updated periodically

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Real-time monitoring tracks capacity utilisation and performance of key processes and services with actionable alerts; scope, metrics and thresholds are updated periodically

controls.title: Key digital services and delivery channels are made resilient: early-warning mechanisms by 30 September 2027 (detect failed transactions and measure availability, monitor affected customers and volume

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Key digital services and delivery channels are made resilient: early-warning mechanisms by 30 September 2027 (detect failed transactions and measure availability, monitor affected customers and volumes, escalate immediately when 5% or more of expected daily customers or transactions are affected), regular reviews of vulnerable interdependencies, and stand-in processing arrangements by 30 September 2027 prioritised for the least substitutable channels with customers informed of terms, risks and responsibilities

controls.title: Critical systems with an expectation of immediate customer or counterparty service are designed for high availability: cumulative unplanned downtime at the customer interface of not more than 4 hours

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Critical systems with an expectation of immediate customer or counterparty service are designed for high availability: cumulative unplanned downtime at the customer interface of not more than 4 hours on a rolling 12 months and a maximum tolerable downtime of 120 minutes per incident

controls.title: Diversity in technology is prioritised so critical systems infrastructure is not excessively exposed to similar technology risks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Diversity in technology is prioritised so critical systems infrastructure is not excessively exposed to similar technology risks

controls.title: During digital service interruptions the institution escalates and decides promptly to resume via alternatives within the 10.32 timeframe, defines accountabilities and third-party arrangements for deg

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: During digital service interruptions the institution escalates and decides promptly to resume via alternatives within the 10.32 timeframe, defines accountabilities and third-party arrangements for degradation, runs a communication plan with immediate customer notice, feedback handling, frequent updates and alternatives, offers a convenient availability-status check (e.g. real-time status on the website), and discloses its quarterly availability track record within 15 calendar days of quarter-end from 15 October 2027

controls.title: A reliable, scalable and secure enterprise network supports business activities and growth plans

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A reliable, scalable and secure enterprise network supports business activities and growth plans

controls.title: Network services for critical systems are reliable with no single point of failure against network faults and cyber threats

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network services for critical systems are reliable with no single point of failure against network faults and cyber threats

controls.title: Real-time bandwidth monitoring and network resilience metrics flag over-utilisation and disruptions from congestion and faults, including traffic analysis for trends and anomalies

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Real-time bandwidth monitoring and network resilience metrics flag over-utilisation and disruptions from congestion and faults, including traffic analysis for trends and anomalies

controls.title: An enterprise technology architecture framework gives a comprehensive view of technology and baseline components, a technical design showing infrastructure, interconnectivity, dependencies and securit

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An enterprise technology architecture framework gives a comprehensive view of technology and baseline components, a technical design showing infrastructure, interconnectivity, dependencies and security controls (to find single points of failure), mappings to business functions, units, applications and data, principles for network and security design, and longer-term priorities

controls.title: Network services supporting critical systems ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of data

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network services supporting critical systems ensure confidentiality, integrity and availability of data

controls.title: A maintained network design blueprint identifies all internal and external interfaces and connectivity, physical and logical, with segmentation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A maintained network design blueprint identifies all internal and external interfaces and connectivity, physical and logical, with segmentation

controls.title: Sufficient network device logs are retained for investigation and forensics for at least three years

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Sufficient network device logs are retained for investigation and forensics for at least three years

controls.title: Safeguards (e.g. logical network segmentation from other group entities) minimise the risk of a compromise in one entity affecting others in the group

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Safeguards (e.g. logical network segmentation from other group entities) minimise the risk of a compromise in one entity affecting others in the group

controls.title: A backup strategy and procedures manage the backup life cycle, keep adequate copies of critical data, OS, programs, utilities, master and transaction files and event logs, store media in an environmen

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A backup strategy and procedures manage the backup life cycle, keep adequate copies of critical data, OS, programs, utilities, master and transaction files and event logs, store media in an environmentally secure access-controlled site, secure removable media per Appendix 1, test restoration periodically with prompt root-cause remediation, and have an independent risk assessment of end-to-end backup storage and delivery

controls.title: A tamper-proof backup arrangement and an isolated recovery environment enable resumption of critical banking and payment services within tolerance after destructive cyber attacks such as ransomware

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A tamper-proof backup arrangement and an isolated recovery environment enable resumption of critical banking and payment services within tolerance after destructive cyber attacks such as ransomware

controls.title: The board and senior management exercise effective oversight of third-party service providers for critical technology functions; the institution remains accountable for all resulting risks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The board and senior management exercise effective oversight of third-party service providers for critical technology functions; the institution remains accountable for all resulting risks

controls.title: Due diligence on third-party service providers is conducted before on-boarding and throughout the engagement, considering at least the Appendix 8 risks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Due diligence on third-party service providers is conducted before on-boarding and throughout the engagement, considering at least the Appendix 8 risks

controls.title: Service level agreements with third-party providers include regulator and institution access rights to records and decision minutes, prior notice of substantial sub-contracting, a secrecy undertaking

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Service level agreements with third-party providers include regulator and institution access rights to records and decision minutes, prior notice of substantial sub-contracting, a secrecy undertaking surviving the engagement, disaster recovery and backup, uptime objectives, exit and termination continuity with timely data recovery, prompt disclosure of disruptions and cyber incidents in the provider's or sub-contractors' environment, compliance with international standards and staff certification, and participation in security awareness programmes

controls.title: A roadmap achieves continuous monitoring of third-party cybersecurity posture: measuring the infrastructure footprint and customer information accessible to third parties, leading product-specific con

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A roadmap achieves continuous monitoring of third-party cybersecurity posture: measuring the infrastructure footprint and customer information accessible to third parties, leading product-specific controls, incident response protocols with providers for software-update vulnerabilities, a priority set of controls with frequent assurance assertions, higher-frequency monitoring of disclosed incidents, automated metric testing, and response to breached thresholds

controls.title: An SDLC methodology covers requirement, design, development, testing, deployment, change management, maintenance and decommissioning, integrated with enterprise architecture, risk management and secur

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An SDLC methodology covers requirement, design, development, testing, deployment, change management, maintenance and decommissioning, integrated with enterprise architecture, risk management and security principles including segregation of duties

controls.title: A comprehensive risk assessment precedes cloud adoption, addressing deployment model sophistication, migration, infrastructure location and geopolitical and legal risk, multi-tenancy and data co-mingl

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A comprehensive risk assessment precedes cloud adoption, addressing deployment model sophistication, migration, infrastructure location and geopolitical and legal risk, multi-tenancy and data co-mingling, lock-in and portability, security configurability, exposure via the provider, termination and data recovery, demarcation of responsibilities and liability, and continuing regulatory and standards compliance

controls.title: Customer, counterparty and proprietary data on cloud services are safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure and access, with ownership, control and management of all such data and services retained,

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Customer, counterparty and proprietary data on cloud services are safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure and access, with ownership, control and management of all such data and services retained, including cryptographic key management

controls.title: An access control policy governs identification, authentication and authorisation of all users to IT assets and data, with granularity commensurate with unauthorised-access risk

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An access control policy governs identification, authentication and authorisation of all users to IT assets and data, with granularity commensurate with unauthorised-access risk

controls.title: Access control adheres to deny-all by default, least privilege on a need-to-have basis, time-bound access, segregation of incompatible functions (development vs operations, security vs system administ

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access control adheres to deny-all by default, least privilege on a need-to-have basis, time-bound access, segregation of incompatible functions (development vs operations, security vs system administration, network operation vs network security, IT operations), dual-authorisation criteria, and authentication by criticality: stronger for critical activities and remote access, robust identity verification at provisioning, and credentials uniquely linked to one user

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication resistant to social engineering, combining two or more of knowledge, inherent and possession factors, authenticates user access to critical systems

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Multi-factor authentication resistant to social engineering, combining two or more of knowledge, inherent and possession factors, authenticates user access to critical systems

controls.title: A user access matrix outlines access rights, roles or profiles and the authorising and approving authorities, reviewed and updated periodically

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A user access matrix outlines access rights, roles or profiles and the authorising and approving authorities, reviewed and updated periodically

controls.title: Access controls to enterprise-wide systems are managed and monitored, anomalies are flagged for prompt investigation, and user activities in critical systems are logged, retained at least three years

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access controls to enterprise-wide systems are managed and monitored, anomalies are flagged for prompt investigation, and user activities in critical systems are logged, retained at least three years and reviewed in a timely manner

controls.title: Rapid development (DevOps) meets enterprise security, governance and compliance requirements, with automated IT security compliance review and automated vulnerability discovery and testing before rele

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Rapid development (DevOps) meets enterprise security, governance and compliance requirements, with automated IT security compliance review and automated vulnerability discovery and testing before release

controls.title: Production is physically segregated from development and testing; on cloud, these environments do not run on the same virtual host

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Production is physically segregated from development and testing; on cloud, these environments do not run on the same virtual host

controls.title: Rigorous system testing precedes deployment, verifying user requirements and robustness; sensitive test data requires authorisation and disclosure safeguards

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Rigorous system testing precedes deployment, verifying user requirements and robustness; sensitive test data requires authorisation and disclosure safeguards

controls.title: Cyber risk management has an enterprise-wide focus reflecting the collective responsibility of business and technology lines

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cyber risk management has an enterprise-wide focus reflecting the collective responsibility of business and technology lines

controls.title: A cyber threat intelligence process collects, analyses and evaluates threat information including data breaches and misleading information about the institution on the Internet, social media and dark

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A cyber threat intelligence process collects, analyses and evaluates threat information including data breaches and misleading information about the institution on the Internet, social media and dark web

controls.title: Flagged anomalous activities are investigated and responded to according to their complexity

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Flagged anomalous activities are investigated and responded to according to their complexity

controls.title: Cyber crisis management policies and procedures incorporate attack scenarios and responses into the crisis management plan, escalation, BCP and DR, with a communication plan for shareholders, regulato

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cyber crisis management policies and procedures incorporate attack scenarios and responses into the crisis management plan, escalation, BCP and DR, with a communication plan for shareholders, regulators, customers and employees

controls.title: A Cyber Incident Response Plan covers preparedness (CERT governance, reporting, roles, invocation and escalation), detection and analysis (points of compromise, damage assessment including threat-acto

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A Cyber Incident Response Plan covers preparedness (CERT governance, reporting, roles, invocation and escalation), detection and analysis (points of compromise, damage assessment including threat-actor claims, evidence preservation), containment and eradication, recovery with contingency strategies, and post-incident review with lessons learned

controls.title: CERT members are conversant with the incident response plan and procedures and remain contactable at all times

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: CERT members are conversant with the incident response plan and procedures and remain contactable at all times

controls.title: A secure, reliable out-of-band communication infrastructure for internal and external stakeholders operates if primary communications are compromised

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A secure, reliable out-of-band communication infrastructure for internal and external stakeholders operates if primary communications are compromised

controls.title: An annual cyber drill tests the CIRP and out-of-band communications on current and emerging scenarios with the board, senior management and relevant third parties, covering escalation, communication a

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An annual cyber drill tests the CIRP and out-of-band communications on current and emerging scenarios with the board, senior management and relevant third parties, covering escalation, communication and decision-making at different impact levels and the readiness of CERT and third parties; results are reported to the board

controls.title: Loss provision arrangements are reviewed against scenario analysis of extreme cyber events; any cyber insurance adequately covers the events and liabilities, its warranties and obligations are reflect

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Loss provision arrangements are reviewed against scenario analysis of extreme cyber events; any cyber insurance adequately covers the events and liabilities, its warranties and obligations are reflected in crisis procedures without unintended exclusions, and insurer obligations do not impair acting in the institution's and customers' best interests

controls.title: Cyber incidents are notified to the Bank per the Operational Risk Reporting, Business Continuity Management and Merchant Acquiring Services policy documents and any other specified policy

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cyber incidents are notified to the Bank per the Operational Risk Reporting, Business Continuity Management and Merchant Acquiring Services policy documents and any other specified policy

controls.title: Cyber threat intelligence is shared with the industry on a timely basis via the Bank's, industry's or law enforcement platforms, with resources allocated to industry-wide intelligence initiatives

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cyber threat intelligence is shared with the industry on a timely basis via the Bank's, industry's or law enforcement platforms, with resources allocated to industry-wide intelligence initiatives

controls.title: A cyber resilience framework (CRF) articulates governance, resilience objectives and risk tolerance against the evolving threat environment, targets operational resilience against extreme but plausibl

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A cyber resilience framework (CRF) articulates governance, resilience objectives and risk tolerance against the evolving threat environment, targets operational resilience against extreme but plausible attacks, and supports identification, protection, detection, response and recovery of on-premises and third-party-hosted systems and data

controls.title: The institution collaborates and cooperates closely with relevant stakeholders and authorities in combating cyber threats

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The institution collaborates and cooperates closely with relevant stakeholders and authorities in combating cyber threats

controls.title: The CRF includes institutional understanding of cyber risk context and posture; identification, classification and prioritisation of critical systems, information, assets and interconnectivity; threat

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The CRF includes institutional understanding of cyber risk context and posture; identification, classification and prioritisation of critical systems, information, assets and interconnectivity; threats, vulnerabilities and countermeasures; layered defence with zero-trust, micro-segmentation and security by design; continuous surveillance for timely detection; incident handling procedures and a crisis response playbook; secure information sharing with other institutions and FMIs; a centralised automated technology asset inventory; and a cyber risk management function escalating high-risk threats to senior management and the board

controls.title: As a designated National Critical Information Infrastructure entity, the institution complies with the Cyber Security Act 2024 requirements, guidelines and NACSA directives and standards

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: As a designated National Critical Information Infrastructure entity, the institution complies with the Cyber Security Act 2024 requirements, guidelines and NACSA directives and standards

controls.title: The Appendix 5 control measures are adopted to enhance resilience to cyber attacks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Appendix 5 control measures are adopted to enhance resilience to cyber attacks

controls.title: A realistic red-team simulation attack on the infrastructure is conducted at least once every three years

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A realistic red-team simulation attack on the infrastructure is conducted at least once every three years

controls.title: Cybersecurity operations have clear responsibilities with mitigating measures for each phase of the attack life cycle: reconnaissance, weaponisation, delivery, exploitation, installation, command and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cybersecurity operations have clear responsibilities with mitigating measures for each phase of the attack life cycle: reconnaissance, weaponisation, delivery, exploitation, installation, command and control, exfiltration

controls.title: Continuous proactive monitoring and timely detection of anomalies via a Security Operations Centre with competent resources and tools, covering all critical systems and supporting infrastructure, with

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Continuous proactive monitoring and timely detection of anomalies via a Security Operations Centre with competent resources and tools, covering all critical systems and supporting infrastructure, with regular vulnerability assessment and penetration testing per Appendix 5

controls.title: The CRF implements robust security controls for digital services: minimum controls per delivery channel assessed regularly (Appendices 2, 3, 4, 11), proper user and device authentication and transacti

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The CRF implements robust security controls for digital services: minimum controls per delivery channel assessed regularly (Appendices 2, 3, 4, 11), proper user and device authentication and transaction authorisation against impersonation and fraud (Appendix 3), and strong physical and logical controls

controls.title: Where the §12 digital services controls are not yet implemented, documented explanation shows alternatives are at least as effective and the institution assumes liability for fraud arising from the ga

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where the §12 digital services controls are not yet implemented, documented explanation shows alternatives are at least as effective and the institution assumes liability for fraud arising from the gap

controls.title: The CRF extends to customers' mobile devices and access points: layered controls protecting the mobile application and its data, continuous surveillance of exploitation with swift control upgrades, in

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The CRF extends to customers' mobile devices and access points: layered controls protecting the mobile application and its data, continuous surveillance of exploitation with swift control upgrades, incident handling to help customers contain damage, coordinated rapid countermeasure upgrades across functions, senior management review with escalation thresholds, and board apprisal of outcomes

controls.title: Fraud detection capabilities and rules are updated promptly on new modus operandi, supported by risk analytics and continuous upgrade per Appendix 11 Fraud Detection Standards

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Fraud detection capabilities and rules are updated promptly on new modus operandi, supported by risk analytics and continuous upgrade per Appendix 11 Fraud Detection Standards

controls.title: Digital service delivery risks are mitigated: secure communication channels with compensating controls for phishing-prone channels (no clickable links in SMS), advance customer information on new cont

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Digital service delivery risks are mitigated: secure communication channels with compensating controls for phishing-prone channels (no clickable links in SMS), advance customer information on new controls, and practical ways for customers to verify calls from the institution or its outsourced providers

controls.title: Customers can manage activation and de-activation of payment cards for card-not-present and overseas transactions, without diminishing the institution's liabilities and duty of care

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Customers can manage activation and de-activation of payment cards for card-not-present and overseas transactions, without diminishing the institution's liabilities and duty of care

controls.title: Customer awareness programmes are continuously reviewed for effectiveness: timely practical fraud-identification information including new modus operandi, clear explanation of security measures and ho

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Customer awareness programmes are continuously reviewed for effectiveness: timely practical fraud-identification information including new modus operandi, clear explanation of security measures and how to verify genuine sites and apps, real-time alerts when measures are absent, and measures such as interactive simulations

controls.title: Customers can conveniently report, suspend and re-activate accounts on suspected fraud: a secure self-service kill switch, an adequately resourced contact centre, and restoration of access within a re

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Customers can conveniently report, suspend and re-activate accounts on suspected fraud: a secure self-service kill switch, an adequately resourced contact centre, and restoration of access within a reasonable time after validation

controls.title: Incidents involving potential fraud or compromised customer data trigger heightened monitoring of affected accounts, notification of affected customers with mitigation information, and revocation and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incidents involving potential fraud or compromised customer data trigger heightened monitoring of affected accounts, notification of affected customers with mitigation information, and revocation and re-issue of affected credentials or payment instruments where exploitation risk exists

controls.title: Scope, frequency and intensity of technology audits are commensurate with the complexity, sophistication and criticality of systems and applications

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Scope, frequency and intensity of technology audits are commensurate with the complexity, sophistication and criticality of systems and applications

controls.title: The technology audit plan is reviewed annually with appropriate frequency and coverage of critical services, third-party providers, material external interfaces, delayed or terminated critical project

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The technology audit plan is reviewed annually with appropriate frequency and coverage of critical services, third-party providers, material external interfaces, delayed or terminated critical projects, and post-implementation reviews of new or material enhancements

controls.title: Internal audit has dedicated, specialised, professionally certified technology audit resources conversant with the institution's systems and delivery channels

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Internal audit has dedicated, specialised, professionally certified technology audit resources conversant with the institution's systems and delivery channels

controls.title: A technically competent external provider performs a production data centre resilience and risk assessment (DCRA) at least every three years or on material change, covering paragraphs 10.24–10.28; rel

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A technically competent external provider performs a production data centre resilience and risk assessment (DCRA) at least every three years or on material change, covering paragraphs 10.24–10.28; reliance on third-party reports for provider-managed data centres is consistent with risk appetite and meets the same requirements; the board-level committee deliberates the outcome

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A technically competent external provider performs network resilience and risk assessments (NRA) at least every three years or on material network design change, covering paragraphs 10.36–10.43; the board-level committee deliberates the outcome

controls.title: Regular technology and cybersecurity awareness education for all staff is conducted at least annually, reflects the evolving threat landscape, is measured for effectiveness, and includes third-party p

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Regular technology and cybersecurity awareness education for all staff is conducted at least annually, reflects the evolving threat landscape, is measured for effectiveness, and includes third-party providers where appropriate

controls.title: Staff in technology operations, cybersecurity and risk management receive adequate continuous training and are competent and suitably certified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Staff in technology operations, cybersecurity and risk management receive adequate continuous training and are competent and suitably certified

controls.title: Board members receive regular training and information on technology developments to discharge their oversight role

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Board members receive regular training and information on technology developments to discharge their oversight role

controls.title: The board establishes and approves a technology risk appetite aligned with the institution's risk appetite: risk tolerances for technology events, a risk owner and residual-risk acceptance criteria an

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The board establishes and approves a technology risk appetite aligned with the institution's risk appetite: risk tolerances for technology events, a risk owner and residual-risk acceptance criteria and authority, key risk indicators, sufficient resources, and regular review

controls.title: The board approves and reviews IT and cybersecurity strategic plans of at least three years, endorses and oversees the TRMF and CRF, requires robust risk assessments for critical systems and emerging

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The board approves and reviews IT and cybersecurity strategic plans of at least three years, endorses and oversees the TRMF and CRF, requires robust risk assessments for critical systems and emerging technology, has IT frameworks and policies reviewed at least every three years, and ensures the framework supports technology applications to the Bank

controls.title: A board-level committee with at least one member with technology experience and competencies oversees technology matters

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A board-level committee with at least one member with technology experience and competencies oversees technology matters

controls.title: The board obtains regular updates on technology and cyber threats, allocates time to discuss cyber risks including extreme-incident impacts with external expert input where appropriate, and participat

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The board obtains regular updates on technology and cyber threats, allocates time to discuss cyber risks including extreme-incident impacts with external expert input where appropriate, and participates in cybersecurity awareness and training
